mapper.sql: ( SELECT pl.ILAW_ID, MAX(pl.ICATE_NO) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY pl.ILAW_NO, pl.IPROM_NO) CUR_CATE, MAX(pl.SGUBUN_ID) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY pl.ILAW_NO, pl.IPROM_NO) CUR_GUBUN FROM TB_PROM pl GROUP BY pl.ILAW_ID )

sql.if: AND ( ( f.ILAW_ID IS NULL OR f.ILAW_ID NOT IN ( SELECT lcr.ILAW_ID FROM lcr WHERE lcr.CUR_CATE IN ( SELECT rr.ICATE_NO FROM TB_CATE_READER rr UNION SELECT ca.ICATE_NO FROM TB_CATE ca START WITH ca.ICATE_NO IN ( SELECT r.ICATE_NO FROM TB_CATE_READER r WHERE r.INHERIT_YN = 'Y' ) CONNECT BY PRIOR ca.ICATE_NO = ca.IREF ) OR lcr.CUR_GUBUN IN ( SELECT gg.SGUBUN_ID FROM TB_GUBUN_READER gg ) ) ) OR f.ILAW_ID IN ( SELECT lca.ILAW_ID FROM lca WHERE lca.CUR_CATE IN ( SELECT rm.ICATE_NO FROM TB_CATE_READER rm WHERE ( ( rm.READER_TY = 'USER' AND rm.READER_ID = #{vo.readerEsntlId} ) OR ( rm.READER_TY = 'DEPT' AND rm.READER_ID = #{vo.readerOrgnztId} ) ) UNION SELECT cm.ICATE_NO FROM TB_CATE cm START WITH cm.ICATE_NO IN ( SELECT r2.ICATE_NO FROM TB_CATE_READER r2 WHERE r2.INHERIT_YN = 'Y' AND ( ( r2.READER_TY = 'USER' AND r2.READER_ID = #{vo.readerEsntlId} ) OR ( r2.READER_TY = 'DEPT' AND r2.READER_ID = #{vo.readerOrgnztId} ) ) ) CONNECT BY PRIOR cm.ICATE_NO = cm.IREF ) OR lca.CUR_GUBUN IN ( SELECT g2.SGUBUN_ID FROM TB_GUBUN_READER g2 WHERE ( ( g2.READER_TY = 'USER' AND g2.READER_ID = #{vo.readerEsntlId} ) OR ( g2.READER_TY = 'DEPT' AND g2.READER_ID = #{vo.readerOrgnztId} ) ) ) ) )

mapper.select: SELECT IFAVOR_NO, SGUBUN, ILAW_ID, SITEM, SDESC, SUSER_ID, SUSER_NAME, SINS_DT, SSYS_ID FROM TB_FAVOR WHERE IFAVOR_NO = #{favorNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_FAVOR ( IFAVOR_NO, SGUBUN, ILAW_ID, SITEM, SDESC, SUSER_ID, SUSER_NAME, SINS_DT, ISEEN_LAW_NO ) VALUES ( #{favorNo}, #{gubun}, #{lawId}, #{item}, #{description}, #{userId}, #{userName}, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), (SELECT MAX(p.ILAW_NO) FROM TB_PROM p WHERE p.ILAW_ID = #{lawId} AND p.SEXISTING_YN = 'Y') )
